title: Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1) (P0420-EXT)
shortDescription: Bank 1 three-way catalyst converting NOx/HC/CO below threshold. Stored as P0420-EXT.
fullDescription: Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1). Bank 1 three-way catalyst converting NOx/HC/CO below threshold. OBD-II monitors emissions and cooling integrity continuously; when readings drift outside spec across two drive cycles the code matures and the MIL is illuminated. Stored as P0420-EXT.
safetyImpact: Vehicle still drivable; will fail emissions inspection. Long-term may damage downstream O2 sensor.

causes.cause: Misfires depositing raw fuel on catalyst
Engine running rich or burning oil/coolant

fixSteps.title: Verify No Other Codes
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm there are no misfire, fuel trim, or O2 codes. Fixing those first often clears the catalyst code.

fixSteps.title: Compare Upstream vs Downstream O2
fixSteps.instruction: View live O2 data: downstream should be a flat ~0.6V if catalyst is healthy, mirroring upstream means cat is dead.

fixSteps.title: Check for Exhaust Leaks
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect exhaust manifold to cat for cracks or leaks that pull air into the stream and skew O2 readings.

fixSteps.title: Replace Catalytic Converter
fixSteps.instruction: Replace catalytic converter (or affected bank). Use OEM or CARB-compliant aftermarket unit.

faq.q: Can I drive with this code?
faq.a: Yes for short term — but the vehicle will fail emissions and continued driving may damage related components.

faq.q: Will it clear on its own?
faq.a: If the underlying cause is repaired, the code will clear after the readiness monitor completes — usually a few drive cycles.

safetyImpact: No drivability impact in most cases; vehicle will fail emissions inspection. Persistent leaks waste fuel vapor.

fixSteps.title: Inspect Fuel Cap
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and inspect fuel cap seal; replace if cracked or worn. Tighten until clicks.

fixSteps.title: Smoke Test EVAP
fixSteps.instruction: Introduce smoke at the service port to locate leaks in hoses, canister, or solenoids.

fixSteps.title: Test Vent & Purge Solenoids
fixSteps.instruction: Bidirectionally command solenoids; verify resistance and that they hold/release vacuum.

fixSteps.title: Replace Faulty Component
fixSteps.instruction: Replace canister, solenoid, or hose found leaking. Clear codes and run drive cycle.

fixSteps.instruction: Apply 12V directly to fan motor connector to verify motor operation independent of control circuit.
